failed.why: NCT00690118: pioglitazone vs placebo in ALS, stopped when the interim analysis showed no tendency in favour of pioglitazone

not_picked: Ponatinib (NCT01761747) and tamibarotene (NCT01337154): pass, but rule 3 takes the two repoDB failures first

Ribavirin (NCT03760666): added to brequinar, the tested drug; etoposide (NCT00660036): background chemotherapy

approved.why: approved for SLE in repoDB; hydroxychloroquine, the most used first-line drug, is left out, and belimumab comes first alphabetically among the rest

failed.why: NCT00430677: abatacept added to mycophenolate for lupus nephritis, failed its primary efficacy endpoint; NCT02429934: abatacept for SLE arthritis, stopped at the interim analysis

not_picked: Ustekinumab (NCT03517722, NCT04060888): passes, but rule 3 takes secukinumab first alphabetically

Ixazomib (insufficient enrollment), levothyroxine (thyroid treatment in pregnant patients), mycophenolate mofetil and mycophenolic acid (background in the abatacept trial)

approved.why: approved for multiple myeloma in repoDB; lenalidomide, the most used first-line drug, is left out, plerixafor only mobilizes stem cells, and bortezomib comes first alphabetically among the rest

failed.why: NCT00412919: azacitidine alone in relapsed or refractory myeloma, stopped for lack of efficacy

not_picked: Paclitaxel (NCT01646762) and siltuximab (NCT01309412): pass, but rule 3 takes the two repoDB failures first

not_picked: Nivolumab (NCT05435053): stopped after 'an evaluation of the safety and efficacy' without saying what it found
